compat_with_soravo_distribution: Soravo root LICENSE is MIT; MIT is compatible. Redistribution (including commercial) is permitted provided the copyright + permission notice is preserved — satisfied by SILERO_VAD_LICENSE_MIT.txt shipped alongside the asset and bundled via bundle.resources.
conversion_or_preprocessing: NONE. Soravo consumes the file directly: SileroVad::new(path, threshold) -> vad_rs::Vad::new(path, 16000). 16 kHz 480-sample (30 ms) frames; v4 ONNX supports 8 kHz and 16 kHz per upstream wiki. No resampling/conversion/export step in the code path (crates/audio/src/vad/silero.rs; apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/managers/audio.rs:287-297).

The LICENSE file text is unambiguously MIT and no separate model-license file exists at v4.0. The anomaly is recorded here for owner/legal awareness; it does not alter the verified MIT license text. If owner/legal determines the anomaly is material, the recourse is a written determination, not a re-verification of these bytes.
